Research

Learning systems grounded in the physics.

One journal publication and two undergraduate research studies form a focused thread: recover distorted signals, adapt faster, and search large equalizer spaces intelligently.

B.Tech (Honors), Electrical Engineering

IIT Madras · 2023–27 · CGPA 9.30

Journal publication · First author

Attention-assisted recovery for photonic ADCs

A power- and sampling-rate-agnostic learning pipeline for nonlinear equalization and denoising in a time-stretched photonic ADC.

With Mandeep Singh, Prof. Deepa Venkitesh & Prof. Lakshmi Narasimhan Theagarajan

Read more ↗

Undergraduate research · 2025

Adaptive DSP equalization

Compared blind equalizers and developed a variable-momentum CMA path that converged up to eight times faster.

Guided by Prof. Lakshmi Narasimhan Theagarajan & Prof. Deepa Venkitesh

Read more ↗

Undergraduate research · 2025

RL for optical impairment correction

Reframed equalizer-coefficient search as a sequential decision problem, from a UCB proof of concept to Q-learning.

Guided by Prof. Lakshmi Narasimhan Theagarajan & Prof. Deepa Venkitesh

Read more ↗

Research direction

From post-processing to communication-system co-design.

The longer-term question is how learning can be woven through physical-layer recovery, link adaptation, embedded execution, and network control while remaining efficient, interpretable, and safe.
